vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Automated Forgejo admin bootstrap and API token generation

narrative.Overview: Implement the automated first-run bootstrap: a shell script that creates the Forgejo admin user from env vars and generates an API token written to a shared Docker volume. Eliminates all manual post-deploy web UI steps. The script is idempotent — safe to run on every container start. Depends on: standalone-mode-stack.
narrative.Traces: FR-5 (admin user creation via CLI), FR-6 (API token written to shared volume), NFR-4 (no secrets in code)

items.title: scripts/bootstrap.sh — admin user creation
items.description: Shell script that: (1) waits for Forgejo to be healthy (polls /api/v1/version with exponential backoff, max 60s); (2) checks if admin user already exists via Forgejo API — if yes, skips creation (idempotent); (3) runs: forgejo admin user create --username $GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME --password $GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD --email $GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL --admin inside the forgejo container. Must handle the case where Forgejo CLI is not on PATH by using docker exec or running inside the forgejo service.

items.title: scripts/bootstrap.sh — API token generation
items.description: After admin creation, calls the Forgejo token API (POST /api/v1/users/{admin}/tokens) to create a token named gjgit-mirror. Writes the raw token string to /shared/forgejo-token (the shared_token volume mount). If /shared/forgejo-token already exists and is non-empty, skips generation (idempotent). Token is never printed to stdout or logs.

items.title: docker-compose.yml — bootstrap service and depends_on
items.description: Add a bootstrap service to docker-compose.yml: uses the forgejo image, command: /scripts/bootstrap.sh, mounts scripts/ and shared_token volume, restart: no (one-shot). Update forgejo service to have a healthcheck on /api/v1/version. Update gitea-mirror (in proxy profile) to depend_on: bootstrap with condition: service_completed_successfully.

items.title: .env.example — bootstrap vars
items.description: Add GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME, GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL, GITEA_URL (internal, e.g. http://forgejo:3000) to .env.example with inline comments. GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD must have a comment warning to change before deploying.

items.title: Validate idempotency
items.description: Manual test and documentation: running docker compose restart bootstrap a second time must not create a duplicate user or token. Document the re-run behaviour in a comment in bootstrap.sh.
